name: MSMT17
description: A person re-identification dataset with 4,101 identities across 15 cameras, including day and night scenes and about 126,000 bounding boxes. The dataset is subject to PKU research terms. This record is metadata-only and vendors no data.
citation: Wei, L., et al. (2018). MSMT17: A Large-scale Dataset for Multi-domain Person Re-identification.
